title: Adaptive Forgetting for Nonstationary Optimization: Towards Robust EEG Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2609.24233v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) provides non-invasive monitoring of brain activity and is widely used in emotion recognition, motor imagery and sleep staging. Although within-subject decoding has achieved considerable progress, cross-subject generalization remains a central challenge in practical applications. EEG decoders are typically trained with Adam/AdamW under a fixed second-moment decay coefficient, even though cross-subject learning involves low signal-to-noise ratios, subject variability, and gradient nonstationarity. A fixed coefficient implicitly assumes that gradient statistics are homogeneous across layers and time, which can limit model's adaptability to cross-subject EEG signals and degrade generalization. To address these issues, we propose AFOR, a tensor-wise adaptive optimizer that converts the fixed second-moment decay coefficient into a dynamic coefficient estimated online from local gradient state. translated_title: 面向非平稳优化的自适应遗忘机制：迈向鲁棒的脑电解码
translated_abstract: 脑电图（EEG）能够对大脑活动进行无创监测，被广泛应用于情绪识别、运动想象和睡眠分期等任务。尽管被试内解码已取得显著进展，但跨被试泛化仍然是实际应用中的核心挑战。脑电解码器通常在固定的二阶矩衰减系数下使用Adam/AdamW进行训练，然而跨被试学习涉及低信噪比、被试间差异性以及梯度非平稳性等问题。固定系数隐含地假设梯度统计在不同层和时间上都是同质的，这可能限制模型对跨被试脑电信号的适应能力并降低泛化性能。为解决这些问题，我们提出了AFOR，一种张量级自适应优化器，它将固定的二阶矩衰减系数转化为由局部梯度状态在线估计的动态系数。AFOR结合了残差……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出了一种张量级自适应优化器AFOR，通过将固定的二阶矩衰减系数转化为基于局部梯度状态在线估计的动态系数，来应对脑电信号的梯度非平稳性问题，从而提升跨被试脑电解码的泛化能力。
en_tdlr: Proposes AFOR, a tensor-wise adaptive optimizer that converts the fixed second-moment decay coefficient into a dynamic coefficient estimated online from local gradient state, addressing gradient nonstationarity to improve cross-subject EEG decoding generalization.
